text:
Mia: kicking off canary for v2-int8-kvfix on prod small buckets. 10% traffic. Watch p50/p95, gen_accuracy, hallucination_rate. evals: https://redwood.internal/evals/1876543210. ping @Sophie oncall.

deploy-bot: canary started @1876543210 — config: traffic=0.10, duration=1h, metrics=[p95_latency_ms, gen_accuracy_pct, hallucination_rate_ppm], auto-fallback=false

Alex: quick note — patched KV eviction logic; changed prefix reuse semantics. keep an eye on "prefix match rate" and token-level diffs.

Ravi: A/B smoke after 15m: gen_accuracy: baseline 92.1% -> canary 90.6% (delta -1.5%), hallucination_rate 4.2ppm -> 6.1ppm (+1.9ppm), p95 latency +12ms. samples show more invented dates/names.

Mia: that's borderline. our gating currently tolerates -1.0% accuracy. I propose tighten to -0.5% for this rollout.

Sophie: strongly +1. auto-fallback threshold suggestion: accuracy_delta <= -0.5% OR hallucination_increase > 1.0ppm OR p95_latency_increase > 10ms. any trigger -> immediate rollback.

Alex: also add deterministic check: run 1k synthetic prefix-reuse prompts to compare logits/match. pushed script: `scripts/kv_regression_check.sh`.

Mia: can we run that on canary hosts now?

deploy-bot: kicked off: `scripts/kv_regression_check.sh --hosts canary --n 1000` — prelim results: 87/1000 failed deterministic-match (baseline 5/1000).

Ravi: red flag. failing cases mostly around "list recent invoices" prompts where model invents dates.

Sophie: plan: (A) pause progressing traffic at 10% and escalate to 0% if any gating condition is met, (B) start rollback if det_check_failures > 20 within first 30m.

Mia: agreed. I'll pause and create a rollback ticket.

Alex: root cause hypothesis — KV cache key normalization changed when we remapped keys during quantization; hotfix branch `kv-fix-normalize` in PR #842.

Mia: action items: 1) rollback if gating triggers; 2) run deterministic script across full canary fleet; 3) hold further int8 rollouts until PR merged + canary green. assigning @Alex to PR, @Ravi to execute rollback, @Sophie to update oncall doc. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary paused by Mia @1876543450 — reason: det_check failures + accuracy delta > threshold.

Ravi: rolling back now. will post when v2-int8 restored.

deploy-bot: rollback complete @1876543710 — traffic 0% -> v2-int8 restored. postmortem stub: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1876543210

Mia: thanks team. we'll run a deeper eval and reopen canary once PR merged and deterministic checks are back to baseline.
